TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd brings a track record of delivering security and infrastructure programs with multi-year operations components, under an ISO 27001–certified management system [CO-PROFILE]. We are incorporated with SECP and maintain active tax registrations (FBR ATL; Punjab & Sindh sales tax), supporting eligibility and contracting readiness for Government of Pakistan engagements [CO-PROFILE].

Most relevant engagements demonstrating capability to design, deploy, and operate security technology stacks aligned to SIEM/SOAR-enabled SOC outcomes include:
- Cybersecurity deployment (Provincial Government): PKR 178M over 23 months, completed 2021 [CAP-049].
- Cloud Infrastructure deployment (Federal Government): PKR 108M over 33 months, completed 2025—directly relevant to monitoring and protection of data-centre and connected-entity environments [CAP-012].
- Cybersecurity deployment (Private Sector): PKR 111M over 16 months, completed 2021 [CAP-025].
- Cybersecurity deployment (International): PKR 143M over 20 months, completed 2025 [CAP-013].

These references evidence our ability to execute sizable cybersecurity programs and sustain delivery over extended durations (including 33–36 month contracts) [CAP-012][CAP-037][CAP-033]. They also demonstrate delivery across federal, provincial, private, and international client types consistent with the Ministry’s multi-entity operating context [CO-PROFILE].

Where the RFP requires specific evidence, we will be transparent: our provided library does not yet evidence three cybersecurity/SOC engagements for government or financial-sector clients within the last five years, nor does it evidence CISSP/GIAC (or equivalent) coverage across all three SOC tiers. We will address these mandatory requirements through named, credentialed hiring/partnering and submission of verifiable CVs and commitments with the final staffing plan.

Finally, the RFP’s mandatory turnover threshold (PKR 1,200M average over three audited years) is higher than our evidenced average annual turnover of PKR 900M supported by three years of audited statements [CO-PROFILE].
